= JSON Schema validation

Libraries for validating data against JSON Schema in JavaScript.

* https://ajv.js.org/[ajv]
* https://github.com/tdegrunt/jsonschema[jsonschema]
* https://github.com/mafintosh/is-my-json-valid[is-my-json-valid]
* https://github.com/ExodusMovement/schemasafe[schemasafe]
* https://github.com/korzio/djv[djv]
* https://github.com/sagold/json-schema-library[json-schema-library]
